question: 设函数 $z = f(x,y)$（$xy \neq 0$）满足 $f\left(xy, \frac{y}{x}\right) = y^2 (x^2 - 1)$，则 $\mathrm{d}z = \_\_\_\_\_$。
reference_answer: 令 $u = xy$，$v = y/x$，则 $x = \sqrt{u/v}$，$y = \sqrt{uv}$，代入得 $f(u,v) = uv - v^2$，故 $f(x,y) = xy - y^2$，$\mathrm{d}z = y\mathrm{d}x + (x - 2y)\mathrm{d}y$。
